notes.note: Reviewed bounded cleanup correction: finalization closes the prior-day arrival fence even if no job is visible, finishes the dimension queue, then selects at most 2000 pending tuples in received-at index order and updates only their materialized ctid array. Retention uses the same tuple-bounded write shape. The scale assertion now checks for the first surviving association instead of fetching every violating row. Standalone PG configuration now matches the main harness five-second idle limit. No receiver timeout was raised. Counts, k support disclosure and epsilon 1/57 calibration are unchanged; source-only/private-deployment limits remain accurate.
